README.md.content:
# Fix the Social Media Redirect Swallowing Issue

Your task is to fix the bug in the navigation system of our social media platform where external redirects are being swallowed. The redirect logic should differentiate between external and internal URLs and handle them appropriately. External URLs should trigger full-page navigations (using HTTP 302 redirect), while internal URLs should use client-side navigation (HTTP 200 with a message). Modify the code in `server.js` to achieve this. Ensure all tests in `test.js` pass when the issue is resolved.
